instructions_to_main_agent: Import Lucide-react icons for clean service graphics.
Ensure every interactive button, input, tab, card, and link has a data-testid attribute for reliable automated testing.
Follow the generous spacing system (p-6, p-8, p-12, py-16, py-24).
Never rely on default transparent dropdowns or unstyled headers.
Make the brand tagline 'One call, one crew, property handled.' prominently visible.
Ensure the quote and work-order submission flows are interactive and user-friendly with Sonner notifications on submission.
